newsitem.title: USA: Jackson Hole closes Florida restaurant.
newsitem.headline: Jackson Hole closes Florida restaurant.

text.p: Jackson Hole Holdings Corp said it closed its Big Sky Steak House in Orlando, Fla., because of poor profitability.
The company said it was pursuing other restaurant ventures to broaden its scope and provide a more diverse earnings base.
The company said it signed a letter of intent to buy Colorado Steak Co and is under a management contract.
Negotiations are also under way to purchase a restaurant group that operates several units in Florida, with expansion plans already in place, the company said.
